title: ArtonaLife SMP
description: A lifesteal Plugin with Custom items.
body:
# ArtonaLifeSteal

**ArtonaLifeSteal** is a modern and powerful LifeSteal plugin designed for Minecraft servers. It brings the popular LifeSteal gameplay experience to your community, creating intense PvP battles and giving every fight real consequences.
Whenever a player kills another player, the killer gains an extra heart while the victim loses one. This simple but exciting mechanic makes every encounter more meaningful and encourages strategic gameplay. Players must protect their hearts, build alliances, and carefully choose when to engage in combat.

The plugin is built with performance, stability, and ease of use in mind. Server owners can easily customize important settings through the configuration files, including the maximum number of hearts, punishment options, messages, and other gameplay features. Whether you want a hardcore survival experience or a more casual LifeSteal server, ArtonaLifeSteal can be configured to fit your needs.

# Features
❤️ Complete LifeSteal system

⚔️ Gain hearts by killing players

💔 Lose hearts when you die

🔨 Custom punishments at 0 hearts

⚙️ Fully configurable settings

🚀 Optimized for high performance

🔒 Stable and reliable implementation

📊 Support for modern Minecraft versions

🛠️ Easy setup and installation

Whether you're running a small SMP with friends or a large public server, ArtonaLifeSteal provides everything you need for an exciting and competitive LifeSteal experience where every heart truly matters.
